objective: Add a standalone ordered/form-based Qt Model Designer that creates, loads, edits, validates, and atomically saves the existing canonical ModelSpec JSON format without requiring users to hand-edit JSON.
acceptance_criteria: A standalone ModelDesigner widget provides explicit fields for model name and three-dimensional input shape plus an ordered layer editor with add, remove, move-up, move-down, and layer-specific parameter controls; drag-and-drop graph editing is not introduced.

The editor covers every currently registered ModelSpec layer type, including structured non-nested BranchSpec branches, through widgets rather than raw JSON text, and preserves the existing prohibition on nested branches.
New model creation starts from a deterministic valid starter definition that the user can inspect and change without touching a JSON file manually.

Load uses the existing load_model_spec API and populates the editor deterministically; invalid JSON, unsupported structure, or validation failure produces a concise actionable error and leaves the last valid editor state intact.

Validation constructs the existing ModelSpec and calls validate_model_spec, then presents either a bounded actionable error or a deterministic per-layer shape trace without duplicating model validation or shape inference rules in the GUI.

Save is permitted only for a valid ModelSpec, uses the existing save_model_spec atomic writer, writes the canonical model-definition schema, reports the saved path, and does not partially overwrite an existing destination when validation or writing fails.
Loading and saving an existing canonical model preserves its semantic ModelSpec representation, layer order, branch order, scalar types, and optional values.
The component performs no training, inference, network, CUDA, background-thread, packaging, launcher, or dependency work and changes no model_definition public API.

qtbot tests use local tmp_path files and inspect widget state, ordering, validation, shape output, error recovery, and semantic round trips programmatically without screenshots, arbitrary sleeps, assertion weakening, or unregistered markers.
claude_prompt: Implement Phase 14 CP1 only in src/image_ai_studio/gui/model_designer.py and tests/gui/test_model_designer.py. Build a standalone PySide6 ordered/form-based ModelDesigner for the existing canonical ModelSpec format. Reuse load_model_spec, save_model_spec, model_spec_to_dict/model_spec_from_dict as appropriate, validate_model_spec, the existing spec dataclasses, and their exact validation rules; do not create a parallel model schema or validation layer. Provide deterministic new/load/edit/validate/save behavior, explicit model-name/input-shape fields, ordered layer operations, layer-specific typed controls for all currently registered layer types, and structured non-nested BranchSpec editing without raw JSON entry or graph drag-and-drop. Validation must show the existing shape trace or a bounded actionable error. Failed load must preserve prior valid UI state; failed validation/write must not corrupt an existing file. Save must use the existing atomic serialization API. Tests must use qtbot, tmp_path, canonical semantic comparisons, and programmatic widget assertions only. Do not run training/inference/CUDA/network, add dependencies or markers, weaken assertions, modify model_definition APIs, touch any other file, or perform Git operations.
estimated_scope: Medium isolated GUI component and focused tests, approximately 500-850 changed lines across two new files.
